description.en: How AI tools read words and make text and pictures, step by step, for students aged 12 to 16. Try each idea in a small model you can play with. Works offline.

blurb.en: How AI tools read words and make text and pictures, step by step.

highlights.en: Split text into tokens and give words numbers
See how a model guesses the next token, one at a time
Watch a picture come out of noise, step by step
Works offline once a lesson is opened
